cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall white rocket with a pointed red nose cone, round porthole window and three red fins at the base.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round silver saucer with a glass dome on top and a ring of small lights around the rim.

cards.name: Robot
cards.subject: A boxy robot machine with a square head, two antenna, round eyes and jointed arms with claw hands.

cards.name: Ray Gun
cards.subject: A toy retro blaster-style space gadget with a rounded body, fin on top and a glowing tip.

cards.name: Alien Planet
cards.subject: A ringed planet with purple-orange stripes and a ring around its middle, with two small moons nearby.

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white helmet with a large curved gold visor and a small collar ring at the bottom.

cards.name: Time Machine
cards.subject: A round pod with a glass door, a ring of lights, and a spinning dial on the front.

cards.name: Space Station
cards.subject: A space station with a central round hub, long blue solar panels on both sides and a docking tube.

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A slanted console with rows of round buttons, colored switches, sliders and a small round screen.

cards.name: Telescope
cards.subject: A long white tube telescope on three thin legs with a small eyepiece at one end.
